name: Mua Cave viewpoint
kicker: A stair over the rice and the karst
summary: Climb for the paddies and the towers, not for a boat. The board charges 150,000 đồng per person and prints no child line. A step count and a gate hour were not printed. The river in the view is the Tam Coc side. That boat stays on the Tam Coc page.
getThere: From the valley, or a ride from the station. Minutes are Check on arrival.
heroCaption: Rice, karst, and the stone steps at Hang Múa

notice.title: This climb is not the Tam Coc boat
notice.body: The view looks over the Tam Coc side of the valley. The Ngo Đồng boat is a different ticket and a different page.

body: The walk is a stone stair to a viewpoint. The wide frame is daylight on the paddies, with the steps in the corner so you know you climbed. A step count was not on the board page or the tourism pages. Check on arrival. The second frame is the valley from the same height: river, rice, and towers, without the stair in the corner.

The ticket is 150,000 đồng per person. No child line was printed, and no rule for a child under 1 m. The hotline on the ticket row is 0987 111 312. The tourism support line is 02293.619.679. A gate hour was not printed. Check on arrival. A street number was not on that ticket page.

figures.caption: The valley from Hang Múa, river and karst without the stair
figures.alt: A green valley, a river, and limestone ridges seen from Hang Múa

gettingThere: The ticket page names the site and a hotline, not a street. From the valley or from Ga Ninh Bình, the minutes were not printed. Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From the valley
legs.body: Ride or walk to the stair. Minutes were not printed. Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From the station
legs.body: A ride from Ga Ninh Bình. Minutes were not printed. Check on arrival.

closed: No weekly closing day was printed. Check on arrival.
